title: Internal decomposition and finite homogeneous generation of a kernel
statement: Let k be a field and S=k[x_0,x_1]. Let F and M be finitely generated internally integer-graded S-modules, compatible with total-degree scalar multiplication, and q:F to M a degree-zero surjective S-linear map as in [lem-sc-p1-graded-kernel-finite]. Put K=ker(q) and G_j={x in K : its image in F lies in F_j}. Then G is an internal direct sum grading on K, K is a finite S-module, and K has a finite set of G-homogeneous elements spanning it.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-p1-graded-kernel-finite] to get closure under source homogeneous components and a finite set spanning ker(q) in F. This span equality makes ker(q) a finitely generated submodule and therefore its carrier a finite module.

proof.text: The component inclusions G_j into F_j induce an injective map on direct sums. Its composite with the source recomposition equals the kernel inclusion after recomposition, so source internality proves injectivity. For a kernel element x, each component of its source decomposition is again in the kernel. Sum these finitely many components in the direct sum of G_j; recomposition gives x. This proves surjectivity and internality.

theorem graded_kernel_internal_finite {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {F : Type v} [AddCommGroup F] [Module (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) F]
    {M : Type w} [AddCommGroup M] [Module (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) M]
    [Module.Finite (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) F]
    [Module.Finite (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) M]
    (ℱ : ℤ → AddSubgroup F) (hF : DirectSum.IsInternal ℱ)
    (ℳ : ℤ → AddSubgroup M) (hM : DirectSum.IsInternal ℳ)
    (hsmulF : ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : ℤ) (s : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (x : F),
      s ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n → x ∈ ℱ j → s • x ∈ ℱ ((n : ℤ) + j))
    (hsmulM : ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : ℤ) (s : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (x : M),
      s ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n → x ∈ ℳ j → s • x ∈ ℳ ((n : ℤ) + j))
    (q : F →ₗ[MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k] M) (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (hgraded : ∀ (j : ℤ) (x : F), x ∈ ℱ j → q x ∈ ℳ j) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal (fun j ↦ (ℱ j).comap q.ker.subtype.toAddMonoidHom) ∧
    Module.Finite (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) q.ker ∧
    ∃ s : Set q.ker, s.Finite ∧
      (∀ x ∈ s, SetLike.IsHomogeneousElem
        (fun j ↦ (ℱ j).comap q.ker.subtype.toAddMonoidHom) x) ∧
      Submodule.span (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) s = ⊤
